notes: vD 65: 'The agreement was for the duration of one voyage'; vD 62: equity associations 'contracted for the duration of a single trading voyage'. Harris 2007 PDF 40: 'the commenda was basically a single-venture contract'. Exception: vD 66 n.8, local and Ligurian-coast commendae sometimes contracted for a time period (outside the long-distance scope). Harris 2007 and Harris 2020 are one witness.

Locator labour-party (CF1=1 in this pass). Harris PDF 10: 'the traveling party would bear sole liability toward third parties'; PDF 11: the commenda pool 'was reachable to creditors of the commenda and to creditors of the traveling party. So was the traveling party's private pool of assets.' Udovitch 198: 'the investor does not become jointly liable with the agent in transactions with third parties; indeed, third parties need not even be aware of the investor's existence.' Venture creditors reach the traveller's own assets beyond any contribution: not shielded. Medium, not high: Harris frames this through Hansmann-Kraakman-Squire, describes a 'prototypical' Eurasian commenda, and takes his legal features from Weber and Udovitch 1970 (PDF 8 n.13), so Harris and Udovitch are one witness on this point.

Extent: the traveller answers to venture creditors out of his private assets with no limit stated (Harris PDF 10-11). Form: Udovitch 198 denies that the investor is 'jointly liable with the agent'; the traveller alone answers (Harris PDF 10, 'sole liability'). 'several' is read as 'individually, not jointly with a co-member'. Low because the value set joins extent to form and the form limb is undefined for a single labour-supplying party; 'sole' has no cell. Alternative: .NR with a vocabulary flag (NOTES, answers 4 and 5).

source_ref: Udovitch 1962, 198; van Doosselaere 2009, 65, 101; González de Lara 2002, 259
notes: No mechanism passes one member's own loss to another: capital loss is 'borne exclusively by the investor(s), the agent losing only his expended time and effort' (Udovitch 198). González de Lara 259: 'indivisible ventures subject to aggregate risk limited the ability to diversify'. An investor spreading money across travellers (Harris 2007 PDF 13) lies outside the arrangement. Low: no work puts the question; alternative .NR.

notes: No work states whether the commenda was a legal person. Harris calls it 'a nexus of contracts' (PDF 8) and discusses legal personality only for the corporation and the waqf (PDF 18, 26). vD 66: traveller and investor were 'socii' in the statutes (citing Pryor 1977, not held). An inference to 0 is available and was not made.

Harris PDF 11 describes 'a new pool of assets, separate from that of either party' but not who owns it; Udovitch 198: 'there is no social capital formed'. Neither answers property held in the arrangement's own name.
Harris PDF 10: third parties could not sue the investing party because they did not know him. Nothing on the arrangement suing or being sued as such.

Harris PDF 11, using Hansmann-Kraakman-Squire: the commenda creates 'a new pool of assets, separate from that of either party'; the pool 'was reachable to creditors of the commenda and to creditors of the traveling party ... But the investing party's private pool of assets was not ... This created an asymmetric owners' shielding and an asymmetric entity shielding.' Read as: the pool is shielded from one member's personal creditors (the investor's), not the other's (the traveller's); no priority of venture creditors over the traveller's creditors is stated. One side present, one absent within the arrangement = P. Low: Harris hedges ('It is possible to conceptualize'), cites no Italian source, never states the investor-creditor limb in terms, and his n.15 is unpinned ('Ibid. p.'). Dissent: Udovitch 198, 'there is no social capital formed', would make the entity question moot. Alternative .NR.

Members' limb unevidenced for the Italian contract (Udovitch 206 reports withdrawal at will only for the Maliki qirad). Creditor limb: Harris PDF 11 has the traveller's creditors reaching the pool, which points against. One limb answered and one unevidenced is .NR.
Locator is founder. No founder: the arrangement is formed by contract between investor and traveller (van Doosselaere 2009, 64-65).
